item.description: The fire under Eurlaos Chrysgratidis ~507 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar was planted on the mound in the Asphodel Meadow.

item.title: Kteides Hides ~320 and Lysnikos Lysides ~605 fell in love in Drepane. The House of Chthoni
item.description: Kteides Hides ~320 and Lysnikos Lysides ~605 fell in love in Drepane. The House of Chthonius pretend not to notice. Drepane had not seen rain in 111 days.

item.description: Andrmedes #8222 the Twice-Born carved Chrysope Hypsnikides ~20's name into a rib-bone and gave it away. They walk together at dusk now.

item.description: Timgenes #6711 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown.
